specs.Qualité: Proof La qualité "Belle Épreuve" est la plus haute qualité numismatique devant les qualités "Brillant Universel" (BU) et "courante". Une pièce belle épreuve est une pièce obtenue au moyen de coins et de flans spécialement préparés et de conditions de frappe particulières, de sorte que les motifs de gravure ressortent avec une grande netteté et que la surface est sans défaut. Les fonds de la gravure sont extrêmement brillants, les reliefs sont matés.

description_detailed: Monnaie de Paris is celebrating the upcoming Olympic Winter Games 2030, to be held in the heart of the French Alps, with a collection that highlights the spirit of Olympic tradition and continuity. Symbolizing a new chapter for the Winter Games, this collection pays tribute to the passing of the flame to France and the momentum that will accompany the arrival of athletes and nations from around the world in the Alps.The obverse of the coin depicts the handover between the Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Games and the French Alps 2030 Winter Olympics Games. Two athletes can be seen, one Italian on the left and one French on the right, recognisable by their wristbands in the heraldic colours of their respective countries. They are passing a snow crystal, symbolising the handover between the two editions. In the background, two mountains in the Alps represent the Winter Games in both countries. The mintmarks of Monnaie de Paris and Joaquin Jimenez are engraved on the obverse. The reverse of the coin features the Italian (left) and French (right) flags in heraldic colours, as well as two mountains from the Alps. On the right is the emblem of the city of Milan, which is participating in the Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Games, and the emblem of the city of Nice, which is participating in the French Alps 2030 Winter Games. The face value and year of issue are engraved.
